verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no published pricing page and no per-signal pricing for logs, metrics, or traces, so it cannot show that costs are predictable without talking to sales. Mentions of keeping storage costs predictable with time series data streams and of cost-efficient tiered storage describe storage efficiency features, not transparent pricing, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales
